record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace dot-product compatibility with jointly trained residual bilinear compatibility: score(h,e)=(h+hW)·e, initializing W to zero. Apply the same transformation to every training position and the existing final-real-position inference state. This starts at incumbent scores while allowing recurrent states to align with the untied output embedding space. Preserve GRU recurrence, features, embeddings, readout selection, loss and optimizer; update checkpoint loading and predictor writing consistently.
